mapper.select: SELECT id, requirement_id, revision_no, design_type, title, content_markdown, attachment_path, status, author_name, created_at FROM dpm_requirement_design WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, requirement_id, revision_no, design_type, title, content_markdown, attachment_path, status, author_name, created_at FROM dpm_requirement_design WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT MAX(revision_no) FROM dpm_requirement_design WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dpm_requirement_design (requirement_id, revision_no, design_type, title, content_markdown, attachment_path, status, author_name) VALUES (#{requirementId}, #{revisionNo}, #{request.designType}, #{request.title}, #{request.contentMarkdown}, #{request.attachmentPath}, #{request.status}, #{request.authorName})
